prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RGBA sprite sheet of FOUR exterior buildings for the second chapter City of Voices of a detailed 16-bit musical RPG. Primary request: tangible three-quarter top-down architectural depth, a broad roof surface, a clearly visible RIGHT side wall, eaves, recessed front door and raised foundation. Exactly FOUR separate buildings in a strict 2 columns by 2 rows grid, square equal cells, square overall canvas. Each building is fully inside its cell with at least 10 percent transparent margin on ALL four sides; do not crop the ground or roofs at canvas edge. Top left: intimate two-storey home, cream plaster, muted blue-grey tiled pitched roof and wood shutters. Top right: small instrument repair workshop, weathered pale stone and olive-painted timber, low brown metal roof with vent, small tools in front windows. Bottom left: welcoming record shop, ochre brick and plum fabric awning, warm copper/slate roof, records visible through front windows. Bottom right: community radio building, stone/plaster front and aubergine painted window trim, muted terracotta roof, small rooftop aerial and a round speaker inset. Same camera, scale, warm cream and muted purple/teal color language across all four, dark crisp pixel outlines, hand-placed pixel texture detail, no sand or postapocalyptic scrap armor (that belongs to chapter3). Front wall faces downward toward player and front DOOR is centered in that front wall at the bottom of the sprite, visible right side recedes upward and right. Substantial roof top area and shaded right wall produce real volume. Fine pixel-art craftsmanship consistent with classic overhead 16-bit RPGs, not photorealism or glossy 3D. Fully transparent background with real alpha, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no ground slab/island, no text or sign lettering, no logos, no people, no decorative surrounding trees. Leave all buildings and doorsteps complete with generous transparent space.
